name: Table
description:
The Table component displays tabular data with native table semantics: each part renders the matching HTML table element (`<table>`, `<caption>`, `<thead>`, `<th>`, `<tbody>`, `<tr>`, `<td>`, `<tfoot>`) inside a styled container.

Set the `size` and `decoration` variants on `<Table>` (or `Table.Root`); they cascade to every part. `Table.Trigger` renders a button inside a `Table.HeaderCol` for clickable (e.g. sortable) columns.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction rendering `Table.Root` and `Table.Table` with a `caption` and an optional `sticky` header

props.name: caption
props.description: An easy to understand description of the table, rendered as its `<caption>`. Required for accessibility unless a `Table.Caption` child is given.

props.name: sticky
props.description: If true, the table header will be sticky.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Table component.

props.name: size
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for size.

props.name: decoration
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for decoration.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.

notes: Give every table a `caption` (or a `Table.Caption` child); it names the table for assistive technology and is visually hidden by the recipe.
Set `scope="col"` (or `scope="row"`) on `Table.HeaderCol` so header cells are associated with their data cells.

For a sortable column, set `aria-sort` (`ascending`, `descending` or `none`) on the `Table.HeaderCol` that holds the `Table.Trigger`, and update it when the order changes; the trigger itself is a plain `type="button"`.
